metadata.description: A small, opinionated set of multi-agent plugins for Claude Code. Two single-agent bridges — codex (OpenAI Codex) and agy (Google Antigravity) — plus contexthub, the multi-agent hub for cross-provider convergence and token-efficient Claude supervision of Codex workers. Superpowers provides the development methodology; Carefully Crafted provides the bridges, convergence, and supervision. Deliberately lightweight by construction.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: OpenAI Codex CLI bridge: image generation (gpt-image-2), hard reasoning (GPT-5.6 Sol at xhigh), an independent read-only code review on explicit request, session resume, raw exec. Structured 5-section handoff spec with audit trail on every call. Optional and installed separately — only needed for /codex:* commands.

plugins.name: agy
plugins.description: Google Antigravity CLI bridge: Nano Banana text-to-image generation through the authenticated agy CLI, and raw exec passthrough. Optional and installed separately — only needed for /agy:* commands.

plugins.name: contexthub
plugins.description: The multi-agent hub for Claude Code: a short cross-provider convergence debate among Claude, OpenAI Codex, and Google Antigravity, and token-efficient supervision where Claude plans and reviews while isolated GPT-5.6 Sol Codex workers implement. Requires Superpowers (auto-resolved on install); the public codex bridge is optional and installed separately.
